name: RSS/Atom Source
description: Turns RSS/Atom feeds into mail items (newsletters, blogs, release notes)
author: MailFlow community
readme:
## RSS/Atom Source

Turns any RSS or Atom feed into mail items, so newsletters, blogs, release notes and CI feeds flow through the same pipeline (classification, summaries, reminders).

### Features

- Multiple feeds per account; configurable poll interval
- Deduplication by entry id/link; entries seen once stay seen
- Standard library only (urllib + xml.etree)
- Read-only: replies are rejected with a clear error

### Usage

```toml
[[accounts]]
account_id = "news"
provider = "rss"
enabled = true
[accounts.options]
feeds = [
  "https://example.com/feed.xml",
  "https://another.example/atom.xml",
]
interval_seconds = 900   # poll interval (default 900)
```

### License

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-mail-rss

把任意 RSS/Atom 订阅源变成普通邮件进入 MailFlow 流水线，方便集中阅读新闻通讯、博客更新和公告。

### 特性

- 标准库实现（urllib + xml.etree），无需第三方依赖
- 基于内容的稳定 message-id，跨轮询去重，不会重复投递
- 自动拒绝回复邮件（订阅源不支持回复）
- 轮询间隔、超时与用户代理均可配置

### 配置

```toml
[[sources]]
source_id = "feeds"
provider = "rss"
enabled = true
[sources.options]
feeds = ["https://example.com/feed.xml"]
poll_seconds = 1800
```

### 协议

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
